hero.title: Minseok Song
hero.subtitle: Founder @ A1trategize | R&D Intern @ KAIST NNFC

blocks.title: Operating Thesis
blocks.body: My strength is Proactive Execution—transforming complex technical challenges into valuable Deep Tech strategies. I want to be someone who values hands-on experience over just words.

blocks.title: Lead
blocks.body: I am currently an R&D Intern at KAIST NNFC and Founder of A1trategize, with a strong foundation in Physics and Semiconductor-Energy Convergence Science from Chungnam National University.

blocks.title: Body 1
blocks.body: My recent work involves designing interdigitated electrochemical devices and developing autonomous robot control systems. I've also successfully self-filed two patents combining deep tech engineering with legal strategy.

blocks.title: Body 2
blocks.body: From utilizing ultrasound velocity for non-invasive glucose monitoring to engineering smart noise enforcement signs using open innovation, I continuously aim to resolve critical technical gaps through structured data and applied logic.

events.title: Non-invasive Evaluation of Glucose Concentration by Measuring Ultrasound Velocity
events.body: 1st Author. 2024 KSNT Annual Fall Conference. Explored the feasibility of non-invasive blood glucose monitoring using ultrasound velocity and robust regression analysis.

events.title: Integrated Agricultural Water Management System Using Big Data
events.body: 2nd Author. 2024 Applied Artificial Intelligence Conference (AAiCON2024). Developed predictive model for reservoir water levels.

events.title: KR1020260015575: Autonomous Robot Control System and Method
events.body: Sole Inventor. Engineered an edge AI architecture for autonomous robots maximizing battery efficiency via vector resonance-based hardware power gating of NPU blocks.

events.title: KR1020260009508: Automated Consulting Report Generation System and Method
events.body: Sole Inventor. Developed a multi-agent automated reporting system utilizing cross-validation among heterogeneous LLMs.
